column7: REVIEW-4557-DEEP-1 MEDIUM-1: the first #4533 fix locked the grantee's user_roles after the ACL upsert, while RemoveProjectMember locks user_roles first, so a re-grant (holding the existing ACL row) deadlocked against the removal and Postgres could abort the removal (40P01). The membership lock now precedes the upsert; the test requires the removal to queue behind the re-grant, succeed and leave no ACL row. Owner variant: TestCTAReview_GrantSecretACLToOwner_vs_RemoveProjectMember_CrossReplicaPostgres; unforced: TestLivenessRace_ReGrantSecretACL_vs_RemoveProjectMember_Postgres
